claim: The host's dp ratio is one float step high at some sizes: D3D9 leaves the render thread's x87 in 24-bit precision, so UiDpRatio's double maths rounds at every step and 1440p x 100 gives 1.33333349 where the correctly rounded value is 1.33333337 (also 1440p x 125; the other D19 cells tried agree). That is the only layout difference between the viewer and the game: a board button sat 1 px off at 1440p, and with the viewer at 1.33333349 all 507 div boxes equal the game's and parity reports no moved tile. Fix proposed for J35: compute it from integers, (float)(h * percent) / 108000.0f, exact in any x87 mode
notes: boxes.py; a float32 simulation of the three steps gives the same value
